issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְנִשְּׂאוּ אֶת הָעָם וְאֶת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים' means 'and they lifted up/supported the people and the house of God' (i.e., they encouraged/helped them), not 'collected tribute from the people and the house of God.' The Chinese '徵收貢物' (levy tribute) reverses the direction and meaning of the verb.
